title: Umphefumulo Oqaphileyo eduze koMfula
intro: Umphefumulo osemusha waphathiswa umsebenzi oyimfihlo, ukubuka usekude njengoba ikusasa lenzeka emanzini. Njengoba engabonakali futhi engalindelekile, lo muntu wayezodlala indima ebalulekile ekushintsheni umlando wesizwe.
clues: Umama wanginika umsebenzi, owawudinga ukufihla nokuqapha.
Amehlo ami alandela ibhere elincane elalihamba emanzini, inhliziyo yami ikhathazekile.
Lapho itholwa yiqembu elingalindelekile, ngasondela, ngigcwele ukwesaba.
Ngabona ukuphelelwa yithemba kwabo ngomnakekeli futhi nganikeza ikhambi ngaphandle kokudalula iqiniso.
Ukungenelela kwami ​​​​okufike ngesikhathi kwabuyisela umphefumulo onakekelayo kulowo owayewudinga kakhulu.
Ezinkundleni zamandla, ngakhuluma ngathi: 'Ngingakuqondisa emndenini ozomondla futhi umnakekele ngokunakekela?'
arabic: ۞ وَحَرَّمْنَا عَلَيْهِ ٱلْمَرَاضِعَ مِن قَبْلُ فَقَالَتْ هَلْ أَدُلُّكُمْ عَلَىٰٓ أَهْلِ بَيْتٍۢ يَكْفُلُونَهُۥ لَكُمْ وَهُمْ لَهُۥ نَـٰصِحُونَ
verse: And We had prevented from him [all] wet nurses before, so she said, "Shall I direct you to a household that will be responsible for him for you while they are to him [for his upbringing] sincere?" (28:12)
